title: Application of Payments to Country Home Loans (Rural Home Loans)
content:
Standard for applying remittances to a Rural Home Loans loan.

## Clauses in force

1. A payment may be applied only while the loan is in active, forbearance or nonaccrual status.
2. A remittance pays the oldest unpaid monthly payment first and is applied, for each monthly payment, to interest, then principal, then the escrow deposit (a monthly escrow deposit), each entry pointing to that month's bill; a remittance smaller than a full monthly payment is not applied and is returned to the member.
3. A curtailment never advances the next due date and never carries a penalty (the prepayment penalty is zero).
4. A payoff pays fees, billed interest, interest from the first day of the month of payoff through the payoff date at the note rate on an actual-day basis of 365, and all principal, booked as a payoff payment of principal.

## Retired clause

**Retired clause — no longer in force; superseded by the current basis.** "Money left after every monthly payment due is paid goes to principal as a curtailment, unless the member designates it for a fee or as a lump-sum escrow shortage payment."

## Status check for clause 1

The status is read from the loan record before the payment is applied, for the loan the payment is made on: active, forbearance or nonaccrual accept payments; applied, paid off and declined do not.

## When a monthly payment counts as paid

The amount paid on one monthly bill is the total of the interest payments and the scheduled principal payments pointing to that bill, less returns of those payments. A monthly payment is paid in full when that amount reaches the monthly principal-and-interest payment.

## Worked order of application (hypothetical inputs)

Two monthly payments are unpaid, each of 1200.00 USD principal-and-interest with interest of 700.00 and a 300.00 escrow deposit, that is 1500.00 each. A remittance of 1500.00 pays the older month: 700.00 interest, 500.00 principal, 300.00 escrow, each pointing to the older bill; the newer month stays unpaid. A remittance of 1400.00, smaller than a full monthly payment, is not applied and is returned to the member.

superseded_clauses: Money left after every monthly payment due is paid goes to principal as a curtailment, unless the member designates it for a fee or as a lump-sum escrow shortage payment.
